title: Steam Mill Yurt

explain.meaning: A round, tent-like cabin with a wooden floor.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Powder Ridge Ski Touring has provided winter backcountry lodging in the Bear River Range of Northern Utah for over 35 years. The Bunchgrass and Steam Mill yurts, both accessed from Logan Canyon, provide access to delightful terrain for all levels of skiers and boarders.
